sentence_stem: Provided that the buyer pays the full price on time,
correct_completion: the seller shall transfer ownership of the goods.
full_sentence: Provided that the buyer pays the full price on time, the seller shall transfer ownership of the goods.
acceptable_variants: the seller is obliged to transfer title to the goods.
ownership of the goods will pass to the buyer.

options.text: so the seller had already transferred ownership of the goods.
options.why_wrong: 'So' reports a consequence that has already occurred, but 'provided that' sets up a condition that has not yet been met.

options.text: the seller shall transfer ownership of the goods.
the buyer has already paid the full price in advance.
options.why_wrong: This states the condition as completed, so it cannot supply the contractual result that the stem requires.

options.text: unless the goods are damaged in transit.
options.why_wrong: This introduces a new exception rather than the result of the condition set by 'provided that'.

grammar_focus: Conditional clauses with 'provided that' and a contractual result using 'shall'
explanation: 'Provided that' sets a condition that must be met before an obligation takes effect, so the main clause must state the obligation that follows.
translation: Alıcı tam bedeli zamanında öderse, satıcı malın mülkiyetini devredecektir.
